gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-cherokee: Warnes tapers its ink strokes to nothing before they ever touch. Noto Sans Cherokee is a sans with a generous lowercase band and a wide-mouthed e, giving the stretched heading somewhere approachable to land.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-chorasmian: Noto Sans Chorasmian gives you a big lowercase and curves that stop short of closing. Warnes adds horizontals and verticals drawn with the same stroke, and that blunt sameness against the open body is the pairing's whole appeal.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-coptic: Wide-set ink lines that taper off: Warnes keeps one stroke width in every glyph. Noto Sans Coptic lets the middle of each line dominate, with uncrowded mouths, so the heading can shout without crowding it.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-elbasan: Warnes is built from rounded rods of a single weight, stretched wide with generous spacing. Noto Sans Elbasan sits beneath it with large lowercase forms and terminals that never pinch shut, a steadier footing for the display letters.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-ethiopic: Expressive and ruler-straight, Warnes draws its stretched letters with a constant-width line. Noto Sans Ethiopic takes over with a sturdy lowercase and c terminals that hang far from the bowl.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-georgian: Noto Sans Georgian reads cleanly and modern, with open curves throughout and short ascender stems on its lowercase. Warnes handles the loud entrance; Noto Sans Georgian handles the staying power.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-gothic: Noto Sans Gothic opens its lowercase counters wide, like drilled glass beads. Noto Sans Gothic rounds into open parentheses, and that generosity is the quality that stands out beside Warnes and its unit-width strokes.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-grantha: Warnes has a flat, stencil-cut feel, every stroke held to a single weight. Noto Sans Grantha sits under it with small, flattened bowls that never catch, so the eye slides from loud to quiet.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-gunjala-gondi: Noto Sans Gunjala Gondi has chunky lowercase strokes like a crayon mark, with terminals cut back to leave a big gap. Warnes grabs attention without pressure swells; the body does the lasting work.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-hk: Warnes stretches wide, tapering its monoline strokes before they touch. Noto Sans HK lifts its brush ends away before each curve closes, so line after line keeps moving without a snag.
